claim_boundary: C03 verifies the simultaneous same-specimen experiment and freezes digitization and modulation-branch requirements. The primary figure bytes and numerical arrays are not acquired, so no curve, exponent, curvature, or anomaly significance is computed.
decisive_reasons: The official publisher metadata and abstract verify a simultaneous same-specimen AC-modulation experiment with Cp and drho/dT channels.
The verified abstract provides only a relation between critical exponents, not numeric exponent values or pointwise curves.
No publisher or author PDF, primary figure bitmap, or machine-readable arrays are pinned.
Axis calibration, pixel uncertainty, temperature uncertainty and shared calibration covariance therefore remain unavailable.
Digitization, curvature and anomaly significance remain fail-closed until the primary figure or author arrays are acquired.
required_acquisition_package: publisher or author PDF or lossless scan containing all primary figures
pointwise or author-supplied Cp and drho_dT arrays if available
sample purity geometry treatment and thermometer calibration
AC modulation frequency amplitude and phase convention
temperature resolution thermal lag and statistical uncertainty
shared calibration covariance between Cp and drho_dT channels
